wrv-about-intro: The Wikidata Reference Validator helps you validate external references of Wikidata items to check if their links are still accessible or now offline. This matters because we want to ensure that we have solid references for statements in Wikidata, so we can demonstrate how we know what we know.
wrv-about-feature-check: Check references and see if they are alive ✅ or dead ❌.
wrv-about-feature-update: Quickly navigate to Wikidata to update dead references with up-to-date and accessible ones.
wrv-about-built-with: Built with ❤️ using Wikidata API, Bootstrap, and a custom backend.
wrv-use-page-title: How to Use - Wikidata Reference Validator
wrv-use-intro: The Wikidata Reference Validator helps you check whether external references used in Wikidata statements are still accessible or have become dead links. This makes it easier to review and maintain reliable references on Wikidata.
wrv-use-step-1: Start typing the name or ID of a Wikidata item in the search box on the homepage. The tool provides autocomplete suggestions directly from Wikidata.
wrv-use-step-2: Select the correct item from the suggestions and click Validate References.
wrv-use-step-3: The tool will check the external references attached to statements of that item.
wrv-use-step-4: Results will show the reference links and indicate whether they are:
wrv-use-step-4-alive: Alive – the reference link is still accessible.
wrv-use-step-4-dead: Dead – the reference link is no longer accessible.
wrv-use-step-5: If a reference is marked as dead, click on the Details button to expand more information about that reference.
wrv-use-step-6: You can then review the statement on Wikidata and update the dead reference with a corrected or more reliable source.
wrv-use-step-7: When available, the tool may also suggest an archived version of the reference, such as a Wayback Machine snapshot, which can be used to replace or supplement the dead link.
wrv-use-example-text: Below is an example of how the tool displays a dead reference. The validator marks the link as dead, shows the related statement, and provides a suggested archived version when available.

wrv-use-tip: Tip: When updating a dead reference on Wikidata, it is helpful to add an archive URL and archive date so the source remains verifiable even if the original page becomes unavailable.
